verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents user-created custom Unified Controls for tracking and implementing controls it does not offer, and these sit alongside its auditor-mapped built-in control list. That covers the custom-controls part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows custom frameworks, custom automated tests or monitors for those controls, or user-defined evidence requirements. Missing for 10: custom framework creation, custom tests/monitors attached to custom controls, user-defined evidence requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones

citations.quote: You can create custom Unified Controls to track and implement controls that aren't currently offered by Thoropass.
Our expert team of auditors has mapped our offered frameworks to a single, core control list
